title: "Healthy Reference VC Calculations"
format: html
editor: visual
---

## 

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(tidymodels)
library(openintro)
library(janitor)
```

```{r}
#read in the healthy reference cohort csv
healthy_reference <- read_csv("/Users/anuraganugu/Documents/xe_gx_healthy_reference_cohort.csv")
```

```{r}
healthy_reference_filtered <- healthy_reference |>
  filter(`Include (1=Yes 0 =No)` == 1)
```

```{r}
#calculate vc/va ref, va ref, and dm/va ref
healthy_reference_vc <- healthy_reference_filtered |> mutate(
    vc_over_va_ref = 15.4 -
      0.972 * (sex == "M") -
      0.0391 * `Age (years)` -
      0.000352 * `Age (years)`^2,
    va_ref = if_else(
      sex == "M",
      -7.9 + 0.0387 * `Age (years)` + 0.0774 * height - 0.000442 * `Age (years)`^2,
      -3.55 + 0.0391 * `Age (years)` + 0.0466 * height - 0.000426 * `Age (years)`^2
    ),
    dm_over_va_ref = 31.8 +
      2.21 * (sex == "M") -
      0.151 * `Age (years)` -
      0.0432 * height
  )
```

```{r}
#summarize mean and sd for vc/va ref and va ref
healthy_reference_vc |> 
  summarise(
    vc_over_va_mean = mean(vc_over_va_ref, na.rm = TRUE),
    vc_over_va_sd   = sd(vc_over_va_ref, na.rm = TRUE),
    va_mean         = mean(va_ref, na.rm = TRUE),
    va_sd           = sd(va_ref, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
```

```{r}
#summarize mean and sd for vc/va ref and va ref (separated by sex)
healthy_reference_vc |> 
  group_by(sex) |>
  summarise(
    vc_over_va_mean = mean(vc_over_va_ref, na.rm = TRUE),
    vc_over_va_sd   = sd(vc_over_va_ref, na.rm = TRUE),
    va_mean         = mean(va_ref, na.rm = TRUE),
    va_sd           = sd(va_ref, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
```

```{r}
#summarize mean and sd for dm/va ref
healthy_reference_vc |> 
  summarise(
    dm_over_va_mean = mean(dm_over_va_ref, na.rm = TRUE),
    dm_over_va_sd   = sd(dm_over_va_ref, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
```

```{r}
#summarize mean and sd for dm/va ref (separated by sex)
healthy_reference_vc |> 
  group_by(sex) |>
  summarise(
    dm_over_va_mean = mean(dm_over_va_ref, na.rm = TRUE),
    dm_over_va_sd   = sd(dm_over_va_ref, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
```

```{r}
#summarize mean and sd for age and height
healthy_reference_vc |> 
  summarise(
    age_mean = mean(`Age (years)`, na.rm = TRUE),
    age_sd   = sd(`Age (years)`, na.rm = TRUE),
    height_mean         = mean(height, na.rm = TRUE),
    height_sd           = sd(height, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
```

```{r}
#summarize mean and sd for age and height (separated by sex)
healthy_reference_vc |> 
  group_by(sex) |>
  summarise(
    age_mean = mean(`Age (years)`, na.rm = TRUE),
    age_sd   = sd(`Age (years)`, na.rm = TRUE),
    height_mean         = mean(height, na.rm = TRUE),
    height_sd           = sd(height, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
```
